) AS [u0] ON [b].[ClientId] = [u0].[Id]
INNER JOIN (

) AS [u2] ON [b].[ProducerId] = [u2].[Id]
INNER JOIN [StudioRooms] AS [s] ON [b].[StudioRoomId] = [s].[Id]
ORDER BY [b].[StartTime] DESC

    SELECT TOP(1) [a].[Id], [a].[AllowClientComments], [a].[Budget], [a].[ClientId], [a].[CreatedAt], [a].[Deadline], [a].[Genre], [a].[ProducerId], [a].[SharedFolderUrl], [a].[Status], [a].[StudioRoomId], [a].[TargetDurationSeconds], [a].[Title], [a].[Type], [u0].[Id] AS [Id0], [u0].[CreatedAt] AS [CreatedAt0], [u0].[Email], [u0].[JMBG], [u0].[Name], [u0].[OIB], [u0].[Password], [u0].[PhoneNumber], [u0].[Role], [u0].[Surname], [u0].[Address], [u0].[BillingAddress], [u0].[CompanyName], [u0].[Country], [u0].[DateOfBirth], [u0].[IsPriorityClient], [u0].[Notes], [u2].[Id] AS [Id1], [u2].[CreatedAt] AS [CreatedAt1], [u2].[Email] AS [Email0], [u2].[JMBG] AS [JMBG0], [u2].[Name] AS [Name0], [u2].[OIB] AS [OIB0], [u2].[Password] AS [Password0], [u2].[PhoneNumber] AS [PhoneNumber0], [u2].[Role] AS [Role0], [u2].[Surname] AS [Surname0], [u2].[Biography], [u2].[HourlyRate], [u2].[IsExternalCollaborator], [u2].[Specialization]
    FROM [AudioProjects] AS [a]
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT [u].[Id], [u].[CreatedAt], [u].[Email], [u].[JMBG], [u].[Name], [u].[OIB], [u].[Password], [u].[PhoneNumber], [u].[Role], [u].[Surname], [u].[Address], [u].[BillingAddress], [u].[CompanyName], [u].[Country], [u].[DateOfBirth], [u].[IsPriorityClient], [u].[Notes]
        FROM [Users] AS [u]
        WHERE [u].[Role] = 0
    ) AS [u0] ON [a].[ClientId] = [u0].[Id]
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT [u1].[Id], [u1].[CreatedAt], [u1].[Email], [u1].[JMBG], [u1].[Name], [u1].[OIB], [u1].[Password], [u1].[PhoneNumber], [u1].[Role], [u1].[Surname], [u1].[Biography], [u1].[HourlyRate], [u1].[IsExternalCollaborator], [u1].[Specialization]
        FROM [Users] AS [u1]
        WHERE [u1].[Role] = 1
    ) AS [u2] ON [a].[ProducerId] = [u2].[Id]
    WHERE [a].[Id] = @id
) AS [s]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [p].[Id], [p].[CreatedAt], [p].[Description], [p].[DurationSeconds], [p].[FileSize], [p].[FileUrl], [p].[IsApproved], [p].[Name], [p].[Notes], [p].[ProjectId], [p].[UpdatedAt], [p].[VersionNumber], [t].[Id] AS [Id0], [t].[AuthorId], [t].[Category], [t].[CreatedAt] AS [CreatedAt0], [t].[IsInternalNote], [t].[IsResolved], [t].[Message], [t].[ProjectVersionId], [t].[TimestampSeconds]
    FROM [ProjectVersions] AS [p]
    LEFT JOIN [TimecodedComments] AS [t] ON [p].[Id] = [t].[ProjectVersionId]
) AS [s0] ON [s].[Id] = [s0].[ProjectId]
ORDER BY [s].[Id], [s].[Id0], [s].[Id1], [s0].[Id]
